assets.name: background
assets.prompt: Create a polished landscape 16:9 game activity BACKGROUND for BunnyDex, final intended size 1024x576. Reference image supplies the brand art direction: luminous purple and gold fantasy collectible card game, adorable white bunny mage, pink ears, purple gold-trimmed hood, rich glossy illustrated finish. This is a UI background overlay: keep the entire central 60 percent of width and central 70 percent of height exceptionally quiet, dark deep plum smooth gradient, no title, no central character, no objects in the center, no bright lights there. Cluster all artwork along outer edges and corners: left bottom edge a cropped charming bunny mage peeking inward with a purple and gold card; right bottom corner a small fan of gold-rimmed purple collectible cards with bunny silhouettes and a few gold coins; delicate magical golden sparkles, purple crystals and soft violet wisps at far corners. Corners richly illustrated, center clean dark negative space for interface. Elegant balanced framing, edges feel like an enchanted card collection table, no enclosing hard border. No text, letters, watermark, UI panels, buttons. Full bleed opaque background.
